notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ لَيْثٌ اَلْمُرَادِيُّ» : the asker is written; «سأله» points at the Imam of prev1 (3013: «رَوَى جَمِيلٌ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ»), the last name of its chain: inherited, last link after the asker
the saying is the Imam's answer to the asker, so the inherited Imam is the last link
